Anthony Trollope, Short Fiction.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/anthony-trollope/short-fiction

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Anthony Trollope, the annotator and the author, died 1882 (Wikidata Q318399, P570 = 1882-12-06).

First publication of the text used: between 1861 and 1882 (SE colophon: 'Short Fiction was compiled from short stories published between 1861 and 1882 by Anthony Trollope.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in between 1861 and 1882, before 1931, so it is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: the country of first publication does not change this result. Every person named above died in 1882 or earlier, so the text is in the public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.
